The *Dhamma Sutta*, also cataloged under the title *Dhamma (nāvā) Sutta* (PTS Snp 55), is the eighth text in the second chapter of the *Suttanipāta* [SuttaCentral]. The core teaching of the discourse employs the metaphor of a boatman to illustrate spiritual guidance: a good teacher is likened to a capable boatman who possesses firsthand knowledge of how to successfully cross over to the further shore [SuttaCentral].
